text: Artificial intelligence is changing the way we work. Many companies now use automation to handle repetitive tasks, which saves time and reduces mistakes. Productivity tools powered by AI, such as smart calendars and writing assistants, help employees finish their work faster and more efficiently. Instead of replacing people, AI often supports human-AI collaboration, where workers focus on creative and complex decisions while machines manage routine jobs. However, these changes also affect job roles. Some positions may disappear, while new ones appear, so workers need to learn new skills. In the future, adapting to AI will be an important part of every career.
